job.title: Customer Success Manager Mexico
job.jdText: All roles at JumpCloudÂ® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description. About JumpCloudÂ® JumpCloudÂ® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.   JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT. About the Role We are seeking an experienced Customer Success Manager based in Mexico to own and manage a portfolio of high-value Enterprise, Commercial and SMB accounts. In this role, you will act as a trusted advisor and strategic partner to IT executives (CIOs, CISOs, VPs/Directors of IT), driving deep product adoption, customer retention, and long-term value realization. You will partner closely with Sales, Account Management, Support, Solutions Engineering, and Product teams to champion customer needs, mitigate churn risks, and unlock expansion opportunities. \n Key Duties & Responsibilities: Strategic Account Management: Develop deep, multi-threaded relationships with key executive decision-makers and stakeholders across Enterprise accounts. Build and execute tailored Customer Success Plans aligned with client business outcomes. Onboarding & Time to Value: Partner with Implementation and Professional Services teams to guide onboarding initiatives, ensuring swift time-to-value and adoption across hybrid IT environments. Adoption & Risk Mitigation: Proactively monitor portfolio health, user engagement, leverage AI and data to address adoption bottlenecks and potential churn risks early. QBRs / Executive Business Reviews (EBRs): Prepare and facilitate strategic, metrics-driven quarterly and executive business reviews with key client leaders to showcase ROI, benchmark health, and align on strategic roadmaps. Growth & Commercial Partnership: Partner closely with Account Executives and Account Managers to develop Customer Success Plans, identify expansion/upsell opportunities, and drive strong Net Retention Rates (NRR) Customer Advocacy & Escalation: Serve as the primary point of contact for strategic account escalations. Advocate for customer product enhancements with Product and Engineering leadership to influence product roadmap priorities. Subject Matter Expertise: Maintain a deep technical understanding of JumpCloudâs platform capabilities, modern IT architectures, and industry trends to advise customers on security and identity best practices. How Success Will Be Measured : Net Retention Rate (NRR) & Gross Retention Rate (GRR) across your assigned portfolio Customer Health, Platform Adoption, and Product Engagement Onboarding Time-to-Value (TTV) for key accounts Identification and pipeline contribution of qualified Expansion/Upsell opportunities Weâre Looking For: Experience: 7+ years of customer-facing experience in B2B SaaS Customer Success or Strategic Account Management, managing Enterprise or high-ARR Commercial accounts  Technical Acumen: Strong industry background with SaaS Products with preferred domain knowledge in IT infrastructure, Identity & Access Management (IAM), Directory Services, SSO/MFA, Mobile Device Management (MDM), Zero Trust, and Security/System Administration. Executive Presence: Proven track record of building trust and commanding credibility with key Business and IT stakeholders, C-suite IT leaders, VPs, and technical stakeholders. Analytical & Strategic Mindset: Ability to synthesize complex customer requirements, evaluate account health metrics, and construct actionable success plans. Communication: Outstanding verbal, written, and presentation skills, with an ability to translate complex technical concepts into business outcomes. Proactive Problem Solving: A self-starter with strong organization, project management, and cross-functional leadership skills in a high-growth, remote-first environment. Education: Bachelorâs degree or equivalent practical experience. Location & Work Requirements : Location: Remote â Mexico. Must be authorized to work in Mexico without restriction. Proficient in English and Spanish Should be willing to travel for customer meetings and workshops - 10% \n #LI-JR1 Where youâll be working/Location: JumpCloudÂ® is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.   This role is remote in the country of Mexico. You must be located in and authorized to work in Mexico to be considered for this role.     Language: JumpCloudÂ® has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloudÂ®, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently.  Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.   Why JumpCloudÂ®? If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloudÂ® is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! Youâll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. Weâre out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. Youâll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.     One of JumpCloudÂ®'s three core values is to âBuild Connections.â To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." - Rajat Bhargava, CEO   Please submit your rÃ©sumÃ© and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloudÂ®.  Please note JumpCloudÂ® is not accepting third party resumes at this time.      JumpCloudÂ® is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.   Scam Notice: Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment.   All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at recruiting@jumpcloud.com with the subject line "Scam Notice"   #LI-Remote #BI-Remote Please mention the word **OUTDONE** and tag RMzQuMjAxLjI2LjE4Mw== when applying to show you read the job post completely (#RMzQuMjAxLjI2LjE4Mw==). job.title: Senior Growth Product Manager AI Native
job.jdText: About Magic Eden and Dicey Magic Eden reached unicorn status in just 9 months after launch, one of the fastest in history. We built a category-defining NFT marketplace from scratch and proved we know how to move fast. Now we're doing it again. Dicey is our crypto casino and sportsbook platform, targeting the $180B+ iGaming and sports betting markets. We're a small, fully remote team. We ship fast, we're hands-on with our data, and we're rebuilding how a growth team operates around AI from the ground up. The role Most of the iGaming industry competes on acquisition. Almost nobody has figured out personalized retention, knowing who a player is, what they need right now, and what would actually change their behavior this week. That's the problem you'll own. This role focuses on the full post-signup journey: expanding our player segmentation framework, designing and running targeted offers and campaigns, and owning the P&L lever that comes with it. It's explicitly AI-native. You'll build workflows, agents, and pipelines to run lifecycle campaigns that would have taken a whole team two years ago. Half the job is identifying the right problem. The other half is running the experiments to find the answer. What you'll do Own retention and monetization as a growth loop. Set the targets, find the leverage, and drive the numbers for everything that happens after a player signs up Own the player segmentation framework. Today it's value and risk. You decide how it evolves, what signals feed it, and how the rest of the company uses it Build the AI-native growth stack. Analysis, agents, and automated pipelines that surface segments, generate offer candidates, and run campaigns with minimal manual work Design and ship targeted offers for specific segments and moments: reload bonuses, lossback, wager bounties, challenges, win-back sequences. Size them, spec them, ship them, measure them Spend real time in our data warehouse and on-chain data finding patterns and turn them into campaigns before anyone else does Expand the signals we have on players: on-chain activity, status-match programs, social account linking, and whatever else you can think of Run the campaigns. Email, in-app, Telegram, whatever the channel. You're hands-on with it, with AI doing the heavy lifting Partner with engineering and design to ship the product surfaces that make all of this repeatable What we're looking for Strong intuition for player psychology and incentive design. Experience in gambling, gaming, fintech, or consumer marketplaces helps. Genuine curiosity about why people behave the way they do is required Deeply analytical. You can go from a vague question to a clean cohort cut yourself, without waiting on a data scientist AI-native by default. You already use AI to write queries, build analyses, and automate your own work and you want to push that much further High output with good judgment. You generate a lot of ideas and know which ones are worth testing first Bias to do it yourself. You're comfortable sending the email, running the query, and writing the spec, not just briefing others Comfortable with ambiguity. There's no playbook here, you'll be building it Backgrounds that tend to fit Growth PM at a data-heavy consumer company MBB consultant who wants to move into product and own outcomes, not just advise on them Product Minded Data scientist or analyst who wants to ship, not just report Why this is interesting Competitive, top-of-market compensation You're defining what a growth PM looks like in an AI-native company, there's no inherited playbook Personalised retention is where the industry is going and we're building it early Real ownership: a segmentation framework, a product surface, and a P&L lever, with a direct line to the founding team Please mention the word **WINNERS** and tag RMzQuMjAxLjI2LjE4Mw== when applying to show you read the job post completely (#RMzQuMjAxLjI2LjE4Mw==). job.title: Team Lead Education
job.jdText: **This position is based in Germany with hybrid or remote working options. Applicants must hold a valid work/residence permit for the respective location.** Chaos is a leading global software company that provides world-class visualization and design solutions, empowering creative minds to bring ideas to life. For over twenty years, Chaos has developed innovative technologies serving multiple industries, including architecture and design, media and entertainment, and product e-commerce. Chaosâ solutions help architects, designers, VFX artists/animators, and other creative professionals share ideas, optimize workflows, and create immersive experiences. Headquartered in Karlsruhe, Germany, Chaos is a global company with offices in 11 cities worldwide. In 2022, Chaos and Enscape merged, bringing together two industry-leading companies into one. Since then, Chaos has continued to grow with the additions of Cylindo, AXYZ Design, and Evolve Lab, further expanding our expertise and solutions across architecture, design, e-commerce, and AI. For more information, please visit chaos.com . Role Overview The Team Lead, Education Sales leads the Education sales team and owns the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for the Education segment, covering both University and Student markets. The role is responsible for driving new institution and student customer acquisition, growing ARR within the existing base, and reducing churn across both segments. The University segment operates through direct, relationship-led sales to institutions, while the Student segment runs as a low-touch, digital-first purchase journey, requiring close partnership with the Ecommerce team to optimise the online funnel, conversion rates, and pricing experience. Reporting to the Sr. Director GTM Strategy & Transformation, this role requires a commercially driven sales leader with a hands-on approach, a track record of owning segment revenue end-to-end, and the ability to coach and develop a team while remaining personally active in deals. The role operates with a high degree of autonomy and suits someone who wants to build and scale a team rather than maintain one. Main Responsibilities Lead and develop the Education sales team, setting clear individual performance expectations, coaching from the front, and stepping into deals directly where needed to support pipeline and attainment targets. Own and scale a proactive, discovery-led outbound motion to win new institution and student customers, continuously refining outreach cadence and qualification criteria. Drive expansion and retention within the existing student and institution customer base, identifying and executing initiatives that grow ARR and reduce churn. Own ARR and pipeline growth within the University segment through relationship-led, direct sales to institutions, tracking key performance metrics and diagnosing and correcting underperformance. Own ARR and seat growth within the Student segment, which runs as a low-touch, digital-first purchase journey rather than a traditional sales motion; partner with the Ecommerce team to continuously optimize the online funnel, conversion rates, and pricing experience. Own accurate pipeline forecasting and attainment reporting for the Education business, providing reliable visibility into performance for sales reviews and senior leadership. Partner with RevOps, Marketing, Product, and Ecommerce to ensure Education-specific campaigns, content, and product feedback are prioritised and executed effectively. Required Experience At least 5 years of sales experience within a SaaS or technology environment, including demonstrated experience leading a sales team with direct accountability for team performance and revenue outcomes. Proven track record of owning a direct sales territory or segment end-to-end, from pipeline generation through closed, retained revenue. Experience managing and influencing a low-touch, digital or ecommerce-led purchase journey (funnel, conversion, pricing) is a strong advantage. Previous experience in Architecture, Education, EdTech, or a related vertical is an advantage, but not required. Required Skills Takes full ownership of commercial outcomes: builds pipeline, closes deals, and drives team performance without waiting to be directed. Leads by example in the field: comfortable coaching team members through live deals and personally engaging in high-priority opportunities where it makes a difference. Translates ARR and revenue data into clear, defensible strategy, is able to identify where performance is off track, diagnose the root cause, and act on it. Communicates with credibility at senior level: presents team results, forecasts, and strategic needs clearly to VP-level and cross-functional stakeholders. Able to build effective working relationships and collaborate cross-functionally across Ecommerce, RevOps, and Marketing: driving digital funnel and conversion improvements for the Student segment without direct authority. Operates effectively with high autonomy in a fast-moving environment: sets own priorities, creates momentum without close direction, and holds a consistently high personal bar for execution and results. Familiarity with MEDDICC or a similar sales qualification framework is an advantage. We welcome people who value teamwork, stick to their commitments and are curious to explore new ways for achieving mastery. If you believe that you are a good match for the job, just send us your CV in English . Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. Confidentiality of all applications is assured. job.title: Junior Payroll Assistant
job.jdText: Through proprietary software and AI, along with a focus on customer delight, Sleek makes the back-office easy for micro SMEs. We give Entrepreneurs time back to focus on what they love doing - growing their business and being with customers. With a surging number of Entrepreneurs globally, we are innovating in a highly lucrative space. We operate across 3 business segments: Corporate Secretary: Automating the company incorporation, secretarial, filing, Nominee Director, mailroom and immigration processes via custom online robots and SleekSign. We are the market leaders in Singapore with ~5% market share of all new business incorporations Accounting & Bookkeeping: Redefining what it means to do Accounting, Bookkeeping, Tax and Payroll thanks to our proprietary SleekBooks ledger, AI tools and exceptional customer service FinTech payments: Overcoming a key challenge for Entrepreneurs by offering digital banking services to new businesses Sleek launched in 2017 and now has around 17,500 customers across our offices in Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia and the UK. We have around 600 staff with an intact startup mindset. We have recently raised Series B financing off the back of >70% compound annual growth in Revenue over the last 5 years. Sleek has been recognised by The Financial Times, The Straits Times, Forbes and LinkedIn as one of the fastest growing companies in Asia. Backed by world-class investors, we are on track to be one of the few cash flow positive, tech-enabled unicorns based out of Asia Pacific. Mission of the role To ensure the accurate, timely, and compliant processing of payroll for multiple UK clients. The UK Payroll Executive will be responsible for managing payroll data, processing payroll transactions, supporting workplace pension auto-enrolment, responding to client queries, and ensuring all payroll activities are completed in line with UK labour laws, HMRC requirements, tax regulations, and agreed client timelines. The role requires strong attention to detail, client service, ownership, and the ability to manage multiple payrolls and deadlines efficiently while continuously looking for ways to improve workflows through technology, AI, and automation. Key outcomes In the first 6â12 monthsOutcome 1: UK Payroll Knowledge & Process Proficiency Develop a strong foundational understanding of UK payroll regulations and processes and confidently apply the appropriate rules when preparing and processing client payrolls. Become fully familiar with Sleek's internal payroll platforms and processes, including HMRC submissions such as RTI, FPS and EPS, workplace pension submissions, and year-end reporting requirements including P60s and P11Ds by the third month. Outcome 2: Accurate & Compliant Payroll Processing Process assigned client payrolls accurately and within agreed timelines, ensuring all payroll data is complete and correctly validated before submission. Ensure 100% compliance with agreed payroll and statutory deadlines, including payroll runs, pension auto-enrolment submissions, and applicable HMRC requirements. Identify discrepancies or potential issues early, take ownership of resolving them, and maintain high standards of confidentiality and data accuracy. Outcome 3: Client Service & Responsiveness Maintain a high level of client satisfaction by providing prompt, accurate, and professional responses to payroll-related queries. Consistently achieve a CSAT target of at least 97% month-on-month while ensuring that client queries and emails are responded to within the agreed communication SLA, with no non-reply tickets or emails left unresolved at the end of the working day. Build trusted relationships with clients by providing clear updates, proactively following up on outstanding information, and handling difficult conversations positively when required. Outcome 4: Team Collaboration & Process Improvement Work effectively with the UK Payroll team and other internal departments to ensure smooth payroll operations and timely resolution of client or processing issues. Contribute to improving payroll processes and operational efficiency by identifying opportunities to use AI, automation, payroll technology, and improved workflows to reduce manual work, improve accuracy, and increase turnaround times. Must-have experience Minimum 1â2 years of hands-on UK payroll processing experience. Experience working in a bureau, outsourced payroll environment, or shared services centre is preferred. Experience managing multiple client payroll accounts is an advantage. Working knowledge of UK payroll processes, HMRC requirements, tax regulations, and workplace pension processes. Experience with payroll software such as BrightPay, Xero Payroll, or similar is an advantage. Strong attention to detail and experience working with sensitive and confidential financial information. Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and meet strict deadlines. Strong written and verbal English communication skills. Comfortable working with data and payroll-related reporting and metrics. Practical experience or strong interest in using AI tools, automation, and IT applications to improve daily workflows. Must-have attributes Ownership & Accountability: Takes full responsibility for assigned payrolls and client accounts, follows through on tasks without constant supervision, and proactively resolves issues or roadblocks. Humility: Open to feedback, willing to learn, and comfortable acknowledging knowledge gaps and seeking support when required. Structured Thinking: Able to organise multiple client payrolls, deadlines, queries, and tasks in a clear and logical manner, while using sound judgement to prioritise competing requirements. Data Driven & Attention to Detail: Comfortable working with numbers and payroll data, with a strong focus on accuracy. Able to identify discrepancies, missing information, or inconsistencies before they impact payroll processing or clients. Can Have Tough Conversations in a Positive Way: Able to communicate clearly and professionally when dealing with sensitive payroll issues, missing information, delays, or difficult client situations while maintaining a constructive client relationship. AI & Tech Savvy: Energetic about adopting new software, AI tools, automation, and technology to make payroll processes more efficient and effective. Behavioural fit is also important at Sleek, and we will be looking for candidates that have a proven track record of embodying the below attributes in their recent roles: We will be looking for candidates who have a proven track record of embodying the below attributes in their recent roles: Ownership: This shows reliability and helps build trust within the team. We move fast and need to know that everyone will see things through to completion and proactively help to get things back on track when challenges arise. Accountability is really important to us. Humility: There is so much we don't know. Humility allows for open-mindedness to feedback and a willingness to learn from others. It paves the way for collaboration and creates a positive work environment. It is a key ingredient of self-awareness and emotional intelligence. Structured Thinking: Our business is complex with many layers (many services, many countries, many cultures). Regardless of whether you're more analytical or creative in nature, being able to show sound judgement is important to us. It ensures solutions are pragmatic and balance the needs of the organisation, team and customers. Attention to detail: You'll be managing multiple client payrolls, deadlines, queries, and workstreams. It will be important for you to keep track of everything and notice when information is missing, inconsistent, or likely to cause an issue. Excellent listener and clear communicator: We have a variety of nationalities and for many people, English isn't their first language. For you to excel, you'll need to be present in your calls and make sure you properly receive and thoughtfully send messages to others in the business. The interview process The successful candidate will participate in the following interview stages. We anticipate the process to last no more than 3 weeks from start to finish. TA Screen / One-way Video Interview: Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a one-way video interview to assess spoken and written communication, relevant UK payroll experience, motivation, and initial background. Technical Round: A 30-minute interview and practical assessment with the Hiring Team to assess UK payroll knowledge, payroll processing experience, attention to detail, ability to work with payroll data, and understanding of UK payroll processes and deadlines. Soft Skills Round: A 30-minute chat with a member of the leadership team to evaluate real-world work scenarios against our core behavioural values, including ownership, humility, structured thinking, communication, and ability to handle challenging situations. Reference Verification: Prior to final offer confirmation, we will conduct one professional reference check with your recent direct manager or supervisor. To keep the process moving smoothly, this step may be initiated during the final interview stages. Requirement for background screening Please be aware that Sleek is a regulated entity and as such is required to perform different levels of background checks on staff depending on their role. This may include using external vendors to verify: Your education Any criminal history Any political exposure Any bankruptcy or adverse credit history We will ask for your consent before conducting these checks. Depending on your role at Sleek, an adverse result on one of these checks may prohibit you from passing probation. By submitting a job application, you confirm that you have read and agree to our Data Privacy Statement for Candidates, found at Sleek.com. Some other great things about working at Sleekâ¦ Humility and kindness: Humility is a core attribute we hire for, which means we have a culture of not taking ourselves too seriously and being able to laugh. Kindness is also incredibly important. We are committed to creating and nurturing a diverse and inclusive environment.Â Flexibility: Youâll be able to work remotely. If you need to start early or start late to cater to your family or other needs, we donât mind, so long as you get your work done and proactively communicate. You can also work fully remote from anywhere in the world for 1 month each year Financial benefits: We pay competitive market salaries and provide staff with generous paid time off and holiday schedules. Certain staff at Sleek are also eligible for our employee share ownership plan and can share in the upside of our stellar growth trajectory as we work toward listing on a prominent stock exchange in the Asia Pacific region. Personal growth: Youâll get a lot of responsibility and autonomy at Sleek - we move at a fast pace so youâll be making decisions, making mistakes and learning. Thereâs also a range of internal and external facing training programmes we run. Weâre also at the forefront of utilising AI in our space and are developing a regional centre of AI excellence. It is our intention that if you leave Sleek, you leave as a more well-rounded person and professional. Sleek is also a proudly certified B Corp. Â Since we started our journey in 2017, weâve been committed to building Sleek as a force for good. In just over 5 years, weâve joined a community of industry leaders like Patagonia, Ben & Jerry's, and P&G who are building an inclusive, equitable, and a regenerative economy. job.title: Senior People & Talent Operations Partner
job.jdText: â¡ This one's going to move fast. We're expecting a lot of interest, so we're running this as a focused hiring sprint. Applications and assessments close September 20, with interviews happening over the two weeks after that.Â ð Where do we hire from? Almost everywhere. Check that your country appears on this page . For this role, you'll have at least 4 hours daily overlap with your UK-based manager. Hi there, I'm Olive Turon, Head of People & Culture at TestGorilla. I'm excited to share more about the Senior People & Talent Operations Partner role and our team. About TestGorilla At TestGorilla, we're on a mission to place 1 billion people in their dream jobs. To democratize opportunity, we're building the world's leading skills-based talent discovery platform - one that replaces reliance on resumes with scientific validation of what people can truly do. Founded as a 100% remote company in 2020, our global team is united by high standards, a lot of heart, and a relentless drive to conquer new technological frontiers. We're all AI-fluent builders who care deeply about replacing bias with fairness. After empowering thousands of companies to hire smarter and faster, we're now unlocking the next phase of our scale-up journey - where you'll play an instrumental role in creating a world where skills matter most! About the role As our Senior People & Talent Operations Partner, you'll own People Ops as a product: the systems, compliance, and self-serve workflows that let most of People & Culture run itself day to day, plus the tooling behind how we hire. You'll join a lean, two-person team, working directly with me, with proper and lasting ownership from day one.Â Payroll, compliance, and HR systems across every (35, currently!) country we operate in are foundational elements of this role. Just as critically, you'll build and own the AI/automation and self-serve layer that keeps our People function lean, bringing a product mindset to everything you touch.Â Letâs face it: weâre a scale-up, so youâll also need to be happy wearing other People hats when the moment requires. We're looking for someone autonomous, opinionated and candid, who'll tell me when I've got it wrong. You'll be dealing with real people and real problems, so you'll need to stay empathic but boundaried, structured and organized even when the pace picks up. Iâm biased, but I think itâs a dream job: this is an HR role in an HRTech company changing the world of work for the better, weâll have immense amounts of fun, thereâs plenty of uncharted territory for you to make your own, and Iâm committed to helping you to do the best work of your life. A quick check: if you've never built objectively clever automations (not just used one someone else built), this probably isn't the role for you. Automation is just that central to the job. Responsibilities In this role, your responsibilities will include: Upholding TestGorilla's behaviors and fostering an inclusive, supportive culture. Designing, building and maintaining a smart, automated and AI-enabled people journey - from pre-boarding to off-boarding - that frees up capacity for bespoke, white-glove treatment where it matters Being the technical owner and orchestrator of our HR tech stack: evaluating and enhancing it, ensuring these tools are not siloed but unified and integrated. Owning the non-Finance side of payroll, invoicing, contract administration, and compliance end to end, across every country we operate in. Owning data privacy and recordkeeping, and the day-to-day relationship with our EOR vendor. Owning configuration and troubleshooting of our hiring tooling, so hiring managers can run their own searches independently. Owning the documentation that makes self-serve actually work in practice, ensuring that itâs structured in a way that is easily accessible to both humans and P&C AI agents.Â Working with me to maintain a clean line between what's self-serve and what needs a person. We do not aspire to automate our entire People journey here.Â What you'll bring We're looking for someone who: Is passionate about TestGorilla's mission to help one billion people find their dream jobs. Has excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Has built and owned sophisticated automations (Zapier, n8n, Make.com, and the like) as a core part of an integrated HR tech stack, not just used AI tools day to day. Arguably the most important thing on this list. Has managed payroll, compliance, or HR operations across multiple countries, ideally through an Employer of Record or a mix of EOR and direct entities. Has deep, hands-on HRIS experience. HiBob experience is a big plus, and so is experience assessing or migrating HR systems. Brings a product mindset: builds for the people who use them (employees and managers), listens to their feedback, and iterates rather than building in isolation. Thrives in a high-autonomy, async-first, remote-only environment, and has worked in these kinds of teams and working cultures before. Marries operational rigor with genuine empathy and a real interest in people. You'll be dealing directly with team members, sometimes on sensitive matters. Is opinionated and candid, with excellent feedback and stakeholder management skills. Most people in this role will have acquired these skills over five years of relevant experience. That being said, we care far more about what you've owned, your impact and how you've progressed, than the exact number of years. We seek diversity and encourage applications from everyone, even if your experience doesn't exactly match the description. Experience influencing design direction for high-impact product areas, systems, platforms or pillars, not only individual features or flows. job.jdText: You're the one people trust with the words, whether you're writing them or fixing them. You noticed thatÂ you loved it, and that you were unusually good at it . If you're also curious about how great design and the responsible use of AI improve people's lives, read on. As one of our Course Writers and Editors, you'll shape how our courses and Master Classes read and flow. The industry leaders whose expertise you'll be turning into courses and Master Classes includeÂ Don Norman and Vitaly Friedman , as well as Design Leads atÂ Netflix, LinkedIn, Meta, and Adobe . Youâll be involved in all stages of course and Master Class creation, including key decisions, so there are incredible opportunities for you toÂ take initiative, make meaningful contributions, and grow . Forget political struggles or long, pointless debates. Youâll be in a team with minimal distance between word and action, where decisions are made ultra-fast. Join the Global Leader in Online Design and AI Education IxDF is the world's largest online design and AI education platform, with over 1,150,000 enrollments since 2002. We hold the trust of industry giants like Adobe, NASA, and IBM, who rely on our courses to train their teams. Prestigious universities, including MIT and the University of Cambridge, integrate our material into their curricula. We have over 1,150,000 enrollments and 1,583 company members, with more than 40 courses, 160 Master Classes, and thousands of open-source design resources, created by our team in collaboration with 240 industry leaders. You make each title engaging, ensure each sentence flows, and edit the written course experience from the userâs perspective.Â This is the role described here. You plan, structure, and create the core content, and you decide what a course participant should be able to do by the end and how they get there. You, the Course Writer and Editor , own how our courses and Master Classes read: the scripts, hooks, headings, on-screen text in videos, quiz wording, and editorial voice across everything we publish. OurÂ Education Designers Â hand you the structure and the exercises, and they'll often hand you draft headings and hooks along with them. The final wording is yours. You'll work closely with ourÂ Co-Founder, your Team Lead, the Education Designers, and the Course Directors , and you'll have a real say in what we make. You'll also work closely with the video team and our growth team. Your Role at IxDF Be a core part of our Editorial Team.Â You'll collaborate with IxDF editors, video editors, and UX and UI designers as well as external industry leaders toÂ create educational content for people worldwide . job.jdText: <h3>Marketing Student Assistant</h3><p><strong>Are you studying marketing, communications or business and looking for a student job where you can build hands-on marketing experience and see how it all comes together in practice?</strong></p><p>Weâre looking for a structured and proactive<span> </span><strong>Marketing Student Assistant</strong><span> </span>to join our Brand &amp; Marketing team at Copenhagen Optimization.</p><p>Youâll work alongside our Head of Marketing, Growth Marketing Manager and Content Strategist, helping us turn plans into action across digital, events, content and campaigns. Itâs a hands-on role with plenty of variety and room to take on more responsibility as you grow.</p><h5><strong>What you'll work on</strong></h5><ul><li><p><strong>Website &amp; digital:</strong><span> </span>Update and maintain website content, event and campaign pages, and help keep everything accurate and up to date.</p></li><li><p><strong>Events:</strong><span> </span>Support conferences and events around the world â from registrations and exhibitor portals to materials, print orders, attendee lists and deadlines.</p></li><li><p><strong>Content &amp; campaigns:</strong><span> </span>Support campaign execution by preparing content assets, landing pages, lists and other campaign elements.</p></li><li><p><strong>Marketing coordination:</strong><span> </span>Keep calendars, project pages, assets and plans organized, coordinate smaller deliverables and follow-ups, and help make sure the practical details don't fall between the cracks.</p></li><li><p><strong>Creative support:</strong><span> </span>Help adapt or create simple marketing materials and visuals. Experience with Canva, Figma or similar tools is a plus.</p></li></ul><h5>Who we're looking for</h5><p>You are studying<span> </span><strong>marketing, communications, business or a related field</strong>, ideally with at least one or two years of your studies remaining.</p><p>You like creating structure, following things through and seeing a task go from idea to done. Youâre dependable, attentive to detail and comfortable taking initiative. We donât expect you to know everything from day one â what matters is that youâre curious, eager to learn and interested in how marketing works in practice.</p><p>You:</p><ul><li><p>Communicate confidently in English, both written and spoken.</p></li><li><p>Work in a structured way and keep track of tasks and deadlines.</p></li><li><p>Take initiative and care about the quality of what you deliver.</p></li><li><p>Are comfortable working with digital tools. We use HubSpot, Notion, Dropbox and LinkedIn, but you don't need to know them all already.</p></li><li><p>Are interested in marketing and keen to learn across different disciplines.</p></li></ul><h5>Who is Copenhagen Optimization?</h5><p>Copenhagen Optimization is the company behind<span> </span><strong>Better Airport</strong>, our software platform built for intelligent airport operations.</p><p>We work with airports around the world to connect planning, resource management, staffing and day-of operations, enabling them to make better operational decisions every day.</p><p>Founded in Copenhagen in 2014, we have offices in Copenhagen and Boston and customers across Europe, North America, Asia-Pacific and beyond.</p><h5>What we offer</h5><p>Approximately<span> </span><strong>15â20 hours per week</strong>, with flexibility around your studies, exams and personal life. Youâll join a small marketing team, work closely with experienced colleagues across the business and gain hands-on experience in international B2B marketing.</p><p>Weâre looking for someone who wants to stay with us for the longer term, become part of the team and gradually take on more responsibility.</p><h5>Interested?</h5><p>Send us your application and CV and tell us a little about yourself, why this role interests you and what you think you'd bring to the team.</p><p>We review applications on an ongoing basis and may fill the position once we've found the right person.</p> Please mention the word **MARVELLOUS** and tag RMzQuMjAxLjI2LjE4Mw== when applying to show you read the job post completely (#RMzQuMjAxLjI2LjE4Mw==).
